# Emails are combined onto the primary, and shared ones are not doubled

**Claim.** The two people's emails are pooled onto the primary. An address both held is collapsed to one entry — matched case-insensitively, keeping the primary's copy — and an email that belonged only to the secondary now resolves to the primary through POST /people/find.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1mergeInto/put`

## Observed exchange

_Each person holds one email of their own, plus one they share — spelled with different case on each side._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Fern",
  "lastName": "Aldana-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "fern.primary-{scope}@example.com"
    },
    {
      "email": "fern.shared-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Fern",
  "lastName": "Aldana-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "fern.secondary-{scope}@example.com"
    },
    {
      "email": "FERN.SHARED-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000002
{
  "vanId": 100000002,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
PUT /people/100000002/mergeInto

{
  "vanId": 100000001
}

→ 200
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001
}
```

_Three emails, not four: the shared address collapsed to a single entry, in the primary's spelling._

_Reachability moved too: the secondary's own email now finds the primary._

```http
POST /people/find

{
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "fern.secondary-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```
